hypothesis: Raising the TabPFN route context from 80% coverage (559,708 rows) to 90% coverage (629,671 rows) improves ranking accuracy, because more labeled rows per final model is a model-family-general mechanism (S6E9: +2.57e-5 and +2.79e-5, 5/5 folds, CIs excluding zero, no other change).
mechanism_evidence: S6E9 deployment-policy audit: 2 half-data bags -> 5 bags on 80% rows improved both frozen finalists under a matched preregistered comparison (reports/deployment_policy_audit_results.json in the S6E9 clone).
S6E10 resource record: peak GPU 13.675 GB at 559,708-row contexts (artifacts/phase17_B1/f0/member_0_stats.json); VRAM total 17.09 GB decimal; linear KV-cache projection at 629,671 rows = 15.39 GB.

matched_design.correction_note: 2026-10-14: transcription fix BEFORE any GPU run - frozen random_state is 1201 (as certified in reports/v7_sol_tabpfn_internal2_aux10_pre_result.json), not 1801 as an earlier draft of this file stated. No experiment has been executed under the erroneous value.
matched_design.conversion_amendment_20261014: Pre-S1 amendment (S1 not yet started; S0 probe in flight). H18-E fold-0 measured a 7.1% conversion of route-level AUC gain into portfolio-level gain (v7's own internal2 change converted at ~27%); both are blends of the SAME route with the same aux10, so route-only gains are heavily diluted at the portfolio level. PREDECLARED S3-LAUNCH RULE (cost control, does not alter the S1/S2 advance rules or the S3 admission gate): S3 launches ONLY IF the S1+S2 mean matched route delta is >= 5.6e-5, which is the smallest mean route delta that could clear the 1.5e-5 portfolio admission gate even at the OPTIMISTIC 27% conversion; otherwise H18-A closes at wave 2 as INSUFFICIENT_EXPECTED_PORTFOLIO_CONVERSION after ~2h GPU.
matched_design.eval_rows: block10 fold 0 apply_ids (69,964 rows, immutable registry data/cache/folds/block10_10f_seed20261010.npy)

control_arm.context: fixed-seed (seed=1801) random subsample of 559,708 rows from the 629,671 non-eval rows

treatment_arm.context: all 629,671 non-eval rows (90% coverage of the full train)

matched_design.frozen_params: identical to v7 certified config: model tabpfn-v3.5-20260909.safetensors, auto_scale_n_estimators=false, random_state=1201, device=cuda, ignore_pretraining_limits=true, fit_mode=fit_with_cache, kv_cache_precision=int8, keep_cache_on_device=true, inference_precision=autocast, categorical_features_indices=[13,14,15,16,18,21], memory_saving_mode=true, n_preprocessing_jobs=1, tuning_config=null
matched_design.paired_metric: AUC on the identical eval rows, treatment minus control; exact pair-credit decomposition as secondary
matched_design.only_variable: context size (559,708 -> 629,671). Seeds, estimator count, params, eval rows identical.

stages.what: memory/timing probe: one fit at 629,671 rows, n_estimators=1, measure peak VRAM; abort if peak > 16.6 GB or OOM

stages.advance_rule: treatment - control > 0 on fold 0 AND no OOM

stages.what: matched arms on block10 fold 1 (fresh eval rows, same seeds)
stages.advance_rule: treatment wins on fold 1 as well (2/2 positive)

stages.what: build the 90%-coverage route OOF: 10 contexts (block10 complements), 2 estimators each; blend 50/50 with the UNCHANGED aux10; compare portfolio vs champion v7 on primary folds with the frozen admission gate
stages.advance_rule: admission gate: mean paired portfolio gain >= 1.5e-5, >= 2.5x paired SE, positive >= 4/5 primary folds

stages.what: certify test contexts (10 contexts x 2 estimators on 299,844 test rows) only after S3 passes

success_rule_primary: S3 admission gate on the 50/50 aux10 portfolio vs champion v7 (OOF 0.9618529228157235), NOT the route-only delta.
stop_conditions: OOM or peak VRAM > 16.6 GB at S0: H18-A closes as RESOURCE_BOUND; do not shrink params to fit (that would be a different hypothesis).
S1 or S2 non-positive: H18-A closes as NEGATIVE at wave 2; no further coverage GPU.
S3 fails gate: record negative; no test contexts.
Cumulative H18-A GPU > 16 h: stop and re-rank.
no_tuning_clause: No seed, smoothing, estimator-count or param change between stages. One predeclared comparison per stage. No public-LB consultation at any point.
champion_invariance: Champion A test geometry is NOT modified by this experiment. H18-A, if it wins, becomes a NEW candidate requiring full certification; v7 artifacts stay byte-identical.
related_hypothesis_id: H18-E (estimator count 2->4, fold-0 discovery already complete, replication pending)
